items.question: Who can join the club?
items.answer: Any student at University College Maastricht can join. Students from other Maastricht University faculties are welcome at most of our events as well.

items.question: Do I need a business idea to join?
items.answer: No. Many of our members are simply curious about entrepreneurship. Our events are a good place to find an idea, a co-founder, or a team that needs your skills.

items.question: Is there a membership fee?
items.answer: Please get in touch by email for the current membership details. Most of our community events are free to attend.

items.question: How can I work with engineering or computer science students?
items.answer: We organise matchmaking sessions where founders present their ideas and technical students can join projects that interest them. Follow our News page for upcoming sessions.

items.question: My company would like to give a talk or offer internships. How do we get involved?
items.answer: We are always looking for companies to take part in our industry events. Email us with a short introduction and we will get back to you to discuss the options.

items.question: How do I join the board?
items.answer: Board elections take place once per academic year. Members are informed in advance and anyone interested is encouraged to apply.
